image/glossary.entries.bench.body.0.en: An interactive bench shows an image-processing effect with controls you can drag, turn, or adjust.
image/glossary.entries.bench.body.0.zh: 机关台用可以拖动、旋转或调节的控件展示图像处理的效果。

image/glossary.entries.bench.body.1.en: On a black-box bench, select inputs and compare them with their outputs to identify the observed transformation.
image/glossary.entries.bench.body.1.zh: 黑箱实验台让你挑选输入，对照输入和输出，判断观察到的变换。

image/glossary.entries.score.body.0.en: An image circuit can be scored by its part count and computation per output pixel.
image/glossary.entries.score.body.0.zh: 图像电路可以按元件数和每个输出像素的计算量评分。

image/glossary.entries.score.body.1.en: After passing the tests, you can reduce computation or part count.
image/glossary.entries.score.body.1.zh: 通过测试后，可以继续减少计算量或元件数。

image/glossary.entries.score.body.2.en: When a task specifies a limit, the circuit must satisfy it as well as pass the tests.
image/glossary.entries.score.body.2.zh: 任务若给出上限，电路必须同时满足限制和测试。

image/glossary.entries.views.body.0.en: The same data can be viewed as a readout, waveform, grayscale image, relief, cross-section, spectrum, or gradient.
image/glossary.entries.views.body.0.zh: 同一份数值可用读数、波形、灰度图、地形、剖面、频谱或坡度等方式查看。

image/glossary.entries.views.body.1.en: Choose a view to inspect different features of the data, such as changes in brightness or frequency strength.
image/glossary.entries.views.body.1.zh: 选择画法是为了观察数据的不同特征，例如亮度变化或频率强度。

image/glossary.entries.views.body.2.en: Change the view for one part or the whole canvas. This leaves the circuit unchanged.
image/glossary.entries.views.body.2.zh: 你可以给一个元件或整张画布换画法。换画法不改变电路。
